description: Pins protocol::rewrite_vault_meta_password_side byte mapping for cross-implementation conformance. The function rewrites the password side of an existing vault.meta — derives a new password_wrap_key via Argon2id from new_password + fresh_salt + existing.account_number_hash, using existing.kdf_params (preserved from the input); AEAD-seals root_key under that wrap_key using fresh_nonce and the canonical password-wrap AAD; assembles a fresh VaultMeta with password-side fresh and recovery-side + items_key fields byte-preserved from the existing input; serializes via the canonical encoder. Recovery-flow.md §4.4 normative property: random_salt_recovery + nonce_recovery_wrap + enc_root_key_recovery byte-preserved. items_key block (offset 281–344) byte-preserved because its AEAD AAD binds items_key_id; binary copy is the canonical safe choice. Function is pure / deterministic — same inputs produce identical output bytes.

cases.description: Canonical input. Existing vault.meta uses distinct byte patterns for every field (so a swap or off-by-one drift surfaces as a clear hex mismatch) and carries `kdf_params = FAST_TEST_KDF` (m_kib=8, t=1, p=1, argon2_version=0x13) — the helper preserves these from the input meta. New password is the ASCII string 'new-pw'; fresh_salt and fresh_nonce are constant byte patterns to keep the vector byte-stable across runs and cross-implementation ports. Generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_vector_hex_for_paste -- --ignored` (in protocol/src/vault_meta.rs).
